description: This file defines a service for an Android app widget, specifically a StackWidget, including the service implementation and a factory class to provide remote views for the widget's collection items. It manages widget data, creates views for each item, and handles lifecycle events such as creation and destruction.

classes.name: StackWidgetService
classes.description: A RemoteViewsService subclass that provides a factory for generating remote views for the widget's collection.

classes.name: StackRemoteViewsFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing RemoteViewsService.RemoteViewsFactory that manages widget data, creates views for each item, and handles lifecycle events such as creation, destruction, and data updates.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Overrides the RemoteViewsService method to provide an instance of StackRemoteViewsFactory for creating remote views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes widget items upon factory creation, simulating data setup and demonstrating a delay.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup, clearing the list of widget items.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of widget items.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Creates and returns the RemoteViews for the item at the specified position, including setting text and click intents, and simulating load delay.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Returns the view to display while loading; returns null for default.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of different view types; always 1 here.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for the item at the given position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable; always true.

methods.name: onDataSetChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the data set when notified, currently does not refresh data.
